Type parameter constraint clause

1 key.

resharper_align_multiline_type_parameter_constraints #

Align a wrapped constraint list with the first where. Read by the C# formatter — this is one of the unprefixed spellings the nine-key "C++ and VB only" claim does not cover — and masked at the export's own values, so the per-option unit cannot reach it. resharper_csharp_wrap_before_first_type_parameter_constraint = true gives the first where a line of its own and leaves nothing on the declaration's line to align to. Measured on constructs/breaks/type-parameter-constraints.cs with that key set to false as well: a second where then lands on the first where's column (46 on the local function, 53 on the type declaration) instead of one continuation indent in. Two flips, so it stays Tier D and unfixtured.
